name: sh_trend_idm
title: Trend stop hunt with an inducement first (any pool, DOL target)
rules: Pools (where retail stops sit, each known before it is used): every pool type.
Hunt: a 5m bar trades 1+ tick through the pool and the hunt reaches >= 0.5 ATR beyond it.
Then: an INDUCEMENT before the hunt (LIT style): a 5m swing within 1 ATR of the pool was taken on the way in.

Trigger within 6 5m bars of the hunt: a strong candle back toward the draw, a body >= 1.2 x ATR(14, 5m), closing back beyond the pool and beyond the last confirmed 5m swing the other way (market structure shift).

Entry: a limit at the middle of the trigger candle for 30 minutes. Hours: any hour 18:00-15:30 ET; max 1 trade(s) a session, one position at a time. Only in the direction of the 1h trend (last closed 1h close vs its EMA 50): the hunt is a pullback against the trend.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the hunt extreme (the protected low/high); stop 6-80 pts, else no trade; size follows the stop.
Target: the nearest untaken opposite pool (any type) >= 1.5R away, banked at 5R; no target that far = no trade.
Management: stop to entry + 1.25 pts at +1R (LIT's BE + costs); flat 15:55 ET (MFFU: flat by 16:10).
Costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick slippage on market entries and stop / time / flat exits. Scored at $500 risk a trade.
data: TradingView CME NQ1! 5m (data/NQ_5m.csv) for pools / hunts / signals; trades walked on 1m bars in 2026 (data/NQ_1m.csv), 5m before
costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick slippage on market entries and stop / time / flat exits; $500 risk a trade (max 50 micros)
